summary: Verified all seven criteria against the live candidate. Controlled consumer tests and repository checks passed; no findings.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: Ran npm run check. Inspected and executed extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts valid-checks scenario: matching version 1 ping reply after 100 ms activates Maestro, preserves its UI notice, and makes no model or delegation request.
Ran npm run check. The no-ping-reply integration scenario observes pending activation at 1999 ms, then inactive state and the required installation sentence in a UI error at 2000 ms.

Ran npm run check. Matching-reply cases independently reject success:false with Unavailable, null, invalid versions, wrong method, missing data, and missing requestId. The emission-error case throws Bus unavailable. Each observes inactive state and the required installation sentence.

Inspected src/maestro/checks/assertEnvironment.ts:124–190 and extensions/maestro.ts command handler. Each attempt emits one request; timeout rejects, finally removes the timer and listener, and command failure only notifies. No retry path or dedicated retry test exists.

Ran npm run check. Inspected and executed successful activation history assertions and the no-ping-reply scenario, which seeds three entries, activates, deactivates, times out, and compares unchanged entries.
Ran npm run check. The active-Maestro/agents-unavailable scenario activates with controlled replies, removes the responder, then deactivates with zero event emissions.

Ran npm run check. The failed-check/retry scenario supplies a successful responder in an untrusted project and observes inactive state with Project is not trusted. Environment integration tests also retain discovery, configuration, model, and read-only checks.

notes: npm run check passed: 37 test files and 212 tests, lint, typecheck, and coverage thresholds. git diff --check passed.

Reviewed affected code against applicable AGENTS.md directives. Tests use controlled replies rather than the upstream ping implementation. Late replies, foreign request IDs, and fresh subsequent requests are covered.

The check command includes automatic fixes. Exact pre-check file comparison confirmed no pre-existing files changed. Removed only generated coverage files and the temporary backup. No candidate, spec, or earlier handoff content was changed.
